chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Suleiman, from Dawud, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'The Month of Ramadan is that in which the Quran was Revealed,' but rather it was Revealed during twenty years between its first and its last.
So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The Quran was Revealed as a whole in one go during the Month of Ramadan to the Frequented House, and then it was Revealed in length over twenty years.'

Then he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The Parchments of Ibrahim were Revealed on the first night of the Month of Ramadan, and the Torah was Revealed when six days had passed from the Month of Ramadan, and the Gospel was Revealed when thirteen nights had passed from the Month of Ramadan, and the Psalms were Revealed when eighteen had passed from the Month of Ramadan, and the Quran was Revealed on the twenty-third of the Month of Ramadan.'

key_terms.جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً: As a whole / all at once

ai.seo_question: When exactly was the Quran revealed according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the Shia understanding of the 'single descent' (Nuzul Wahid) of the Quran to the Bait al-Ma'mur, reconciling it with the 'gradual descent' (Tadrij) over twenty years. It further contextualizes the revelation timeline by aligning the descent of previous scriptures with specific nights in Ramadan, highlighting the Quran's final and complete revelation on the 23rd night, a key date for Laylat al-Qadr.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Al Qasim, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Dawood, from Hafs Bin Giyas,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:185] The Month of Ramazan is that in which the Quran was Revealed, but rather it was Revealed during twenty years between its first and its last’.

So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Quran was Revealed as a whole in one go during the Month of Ramazan to the Frequented House (البيت المعمور), and then it was Revealed in length over twenty years’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Parchment of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup> was Revealed during the first night from the Month of Ramazan, and the Torah was Revealed when two (days) had not lapsed from the Month of Ramazan, and the Evangel, when thirteen nights from the Month of Ramazan, and the Psalms was Revealed on the eighteenth from the Month of Ramazan, and the Quran was Revealed during the twenty-third from the Month of Ramazan’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from Dawud from Hafs ibn Ghiyath who has said the following: “

Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘The month of Ramadan is the month in which the Quran was revealed, . . .’ [2:185] but there were twenty years between its first and last (words).’
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) said, ‘The Holy Quran was revealed in one piece in the month of Ramadan to Bayt al-Ma ’mur, then it was revealed in twenty years.’

The Imam said, ‘The Holy Prophet has said, “The books of Ibrahim were revealed in the first night of Ramadan, Torah was revealed on the sixth day of Ramadan, lnjil was revealed after thirteen nights of the month of Ramadan had passed, al-Zabur was revealed after twenty six days were passed from the month of Ramadan and the Holy Quran was revealed after twenty-three days had passed from the month of Ramadan.’”
